g.text: open-weight AI from a USB stick
/help · Ctrl-T next model · /mode · Ctrl-C stops a reply
What does open-weight mean? Two sentences.
It means the trained model itself, the file of weights, is published for anyone to download and run
on their own computer. You can use it offline and nobody sees your prompts, though the training data
and code are often not released.
* qwen3.5:4b 3.4 GB The best all-rounder for 8 GB laptops: chat, code, images,
qwen3-coder:30b 19.0 GB The best coding agent that runs on a laptop CPU (3.3B
